intended: Hello troop families, here's a recap of last weekend's campout. We left the church parking lot at 5:30 on Friday and got to the site by 7, after a short stop for gas. The scouts pitched tents before dark, which was a record, and then we had hot dogs by the fire. Saturday started with pancakes, thanks to Abdul, then a hike of 5 miles to the waterfall, the longer route was closed. After lunch the scouts practiced knots and first aid, then there was a free swim in the lake. The rain started around 10 on Saturday night, and everyone stayed dry thanks to the tarps. We packed up on Sunday morning and were back at the church by 2. Thank you to everyone who helped. See you at the next meeting, Caleb
